@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: As the UK's a______r, Mr. Pierce works in the US, representing his country there.
= ambassador
~詞義 ambassador（n.）大使
~原文 As the UK's ambassador, Mr. Pierce works in the US, representing his country there.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Be sure to carry your p______t with you at all times when you are traveling abroad.
= passport
~詞義 passport（n.）護照
~原文 Be sure to carry your passport with you at all times when you are traveling abroad.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The boy didn't like to wash his hair because he hated the feeling of s______o getting in his eyes.
= shampoo
~詞義 shampoo（n.）洗髮精
~原文 The boy didn't like to wash his hair because he hated the feeling of shampoo getting in his eyes.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It was a g______s victory for the badminton player to win an Olympic medal.
= glorious
~詞義 glorious（adj.）光榮的
~原文 It was a glorious victory for the badminton player to win an Olympic medal.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: For Mrs. Brown, the worst part of the divorce was the s______n from her beloved son.
= separation
~詞義 separation（n.）分離
~原文 For Mrs. Brown, the worst part of the divorce was the separation from her beloved son.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Cotton is the main ______ material used in the production of many types of clothing.
A: icy
B: dim
C: further
D: raw
= D
~詞義 raw（adj.）原物料(raw material)
~原文 Cotton is the main raw material used in the production of many types of clothing.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The train ______ from Taipei to Kaohsiung is more than NT$800.
A: fare
B: hay
C: pint
D: dime
= A
~詞義 fare（n.）車費
~原文 The train fare from Taipei to Kaohsiung is more than NT$800.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ was re-elected two years ago, so he has now governed this city for six years.
A: nickel
B: berry
C: mayor
D: glory
= C
~詞義 mayor（n.）市長
~原文 The mayor was re-elected two years ago, so he has now governed this city for six years.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: A tip for packing for a business trip is to keep your ______ light and small. That way, it's much easier to carry, and you can take it aboard the plane.
A: elbow
B: quarter
C: luggage
D: meadow
= C
~詞義 luggage（n.）行李
~原文 A tip for packing for a business trip is to keep your luggage light and small. That way, it's much easier to carry, and you can take it aboard the plane.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Young children are only allowed to swim in that small pool, which is very ______.
A: joyful
B: inner
C: farther
D: shallow
= D
~詞義 shallow（adj.）淺的
~原文 Young children are only allowed to swim in that small pool, which is very shallow.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: knitted
B: paused
C: dim
D: meadow
E: elbow
F: penny

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: This park is a popular place for families because it contains a big ______ where they can have picnics and fly kites.
= D
~詞義 meadow（n.）草地
~原文 This park is a popular place for families because it contains a big meadow where they can have picnics and fly kites.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Yesterday, I met a rude woman who pushed me aside with her ______ and didn't apologize.
= E
~詞義 elbow（n.）手肘
~原文 Yesterday, I met a rude woman who pushed me aside with her elbow and didn't apologize.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Charles ______ for a moment and rubbed his eyes. He had been reading for too long.
= B
~詞義 pause（v.）暫停
~原文 Charles paused for a moment and rubbed his eyes. He had been reading for too long.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The charitable organization reminds people that even a single ______ can help make a difference.
= F
~詞義 penny（n.）一分錢
~原文 The charitable organization reminds people that even a single penny can help make a difference.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The light over my seat is so ______ that I can barely read the book.
= C
~詞義 dim（adj.）微暗的
~原文 The light over my seat is so dim that I can barely read the book.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: junk

C: chat

E: pills
F: glance

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: My brother's room is filled with ______. He never throws anything away; he just piles unwanted objects up on the floor.
= A
~詞義 junk（n.）無用的舊物
~原文 My brother's room is filled with junk. He never throws anything away; he just piles unwanted objects up on the floor.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: "I'd love to have a(n) ______ with you after class about your essay ideas," the professor said.
= C
~詞義 chat（n.）閒聊
~原文 "I'd love to have a(n) chat with you after class about your essay ideas," the professor said.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Doctors usually don't give young children medicine in the form of ______ because they may not be able to swallow them.
= E
~詞義 pill（n.）藥丸
~原文 Doctors usually don't give young children medicine in the form of pills because they may not be able to swallow them.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: After you ______ an orange, you can keep the skin and make soap with it.
= D
~詞義 peel（v.）剝皮
~原文 After you peel an orange, you can keep the skin and make soap with it.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Lucy is said to ______ Tom an apology because she spread a rumor about him without checking the facts first.
= B
~詞義 owe（v.）欠
~原文 Lucy is said to owe Tom an apology because she spread a rumor about him without checking the facts first.
